results.title: Releases · hainguyents13/mechvibes · GitHub
results.content:
MechvibesDX officially becomes Mechvibes 3. It replaces the original Mechvibes app (version 2), so the version number carries on from there: after 0.8.4 comes 3.0.0, and the app is now simply called Mechvibes. What to do:
  + Windows, coming from MechvibesDX: nothing special. Click Download & install when the app offers the update, or run the new installer. Your settings, sound packs and "Start at login" carry over. Don't uninstall MechvibesDX first, because that deletes your settings and sound packs.
  + Windows, coming from Mechvibes 2: run the new installer. It finds Mechvibes 2 and offers to remove it: click Yes, or every key will play twice.
  + Linux: install the new `.deb` as usual. It replaces MechvibesDX or Mechvibes 2 by itself. [...] chore(ci): ping the Release Updates role instead of everyone by @hainguyents13 in #117
 fix(mouse): read buttons from the input devices on Wayland by @TomasCuevas in #105
 Ignores build directory by @Palatis in #123
 docs(evdev): stop calling rdev the reference for the pointer button names by @TomasCuevas in #118
 fix(soundpacks): refuse an import whose ID already exists by @TomasCuevas in #110
 feat(input): read the mouse wheel from the input devices on Wayland by @TomasCuevas in #109
 chore: point links and the update check at the renamed repository by @hainguyents13 in #130
 feat: rename the app from MechvibesDX to Mechvibes (3.0.0) by @hainguyents13 in #131
 docs: describe the Linux input listeners as they run today by @hainguyents13 in #125 [...] ## What's Changed

 feat: bring over Mechvibes 2 sound packs and offer to trash MechvibesDX.app by @hainguyents13 in #134
 Library pack format spec and headless pack-convert by @hainguyents13 in #126
 docs(readme): rewrite for Mechvibes 3 and add a cover image by @hainguyents13 in #135
 docs(converter): say a V1 single key converts to one keydown segment by @hainguyents13 in #136
 test(converter): a V1 keyboard pack keeps one keydown segment per key by @hainguyents13 in #137
